text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Inhaaaale, exhaaaale...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
――Alright. I can't just mope around like 
this forever! Nothing's gonna change 
unless I take action!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: ...Still, how should I bring it up?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, of course, a greeting comes first, 
right? 'Trainer <username>, thank you for your hard 
work'――

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Right, right, and then I—

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Wait, wha-wha-what!? Th-The real deal!?
choice_data_list: Did you need something from me?
Did you need something from me?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: U-Um, well, that's...!!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
...A-Actually, you see... How should I put 
it, what I mean is...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: W-Would you be interested in karaoke!?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: ...! Is that true?!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Um... In that case, by all means, let's 
start now...!

Though it was a rather abrupt suggestion, 
I gladly accepted, and headed to the 
karaoke lounge alongside Trainer Kiryuin.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: ...I came... after all.
choice_data_list: Is karaoke a hobby of yours?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Ah, no――

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
...I'm sorry, it has been so many years 
that I can't even remember the last time I 
came.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
The last time I came here was probably... 
back in preschool...?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
So, I've completely forgotten the 
etiquette... Do we enter the songs using 
this telephone?
choice_data_list: No, on that tablet over there……

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Ah, yes...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
...I'm so sorry!! For suddenly asking such 
a strange favor of you!!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: U-Um... a-actually...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Umm... Ah, there you are. Meek, ――

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Whhaaat!? Meek-chan, you've never hung out 
with your Trainer before!?

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: ...Not really.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Is that so~. On my days off, I often go to 
the arcade with my Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Looks like my Trainer's into gaming. 
They're super good at it~. They've been 
teaching me, and I've been getting better 
bit by bit too!

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
...Is that so? ..................Sounds 
fun.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I'm embarrassed to admit it, but…… I 
really don't have any hobbies.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Or rather, reading training guidebooks, 
rethinking routines, compiling data... my 
work is kind of my hobby...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
In other words, um, I have absolutely no 
hobbies that I could enjoy together with 
Meek...!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Still, I cannot bear to let her go on 
feeling so bored...!
choice_data_list:
So that's why you suddenly went to 
karaoke……?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes. It was when I was very young, but I 
remember my mother bringing me here.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Even so, that was the only time, so I 
figured I should visit often enough to 
call it a proper hobby...!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Honestly... all I've ever done is study. 
Back when I was a student, and even now...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: ...Why am I... always like this...?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Ah... S-Sorry, you're right!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Well then, if I may be so bold, I shall 
sing first...!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
The little acorn rolled around, plop into 
the pond~♪ Splash, splash, into the deep, 
oh what a big mess~♪

...A repertoire consisting solely of 
nursery rhymes echoed with remarkable, 
melodious beauty.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
*cough, cough*... Ah, I used my voice a 
bit too much. Ahaha...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, thank you so much for 
keeping me company today!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Really...! That's... yeah, that's such a 
relief, truly!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
...Um, Trainer <username>. If you wouldn't mind, 
that is—

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Would you... be willing to indulge my 
"hobby" once again?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Of course, only whenever you have some 
free time...!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Yes!! I look forward to working with 
you...!!

With Trainer Kiryuin's expression 
brightening up, we had an enjoyable chat 
on our way home.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Ah... I-Is that so?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I am sorry for asking such a strange 
question out of nowhere...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Um... Well, that's all I wanted to say. 
Please forget it.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: I apologize for the intrusion...

Her shoulders slumping in deep 
disappointment, Trainer Kiryuin walked 
away...
